SearchAliases: keep three inches off the hook
Senses.Note: Three inches from the hook is the encounter position in Chuanzi Decheng’s case: after lowering a thousand-foot line into the deep pool, he demands speech before the respondent closes on the hook. Later masters ask for the exact hook-distance phrase.
